run_get_data: run get_data to parse a JSON file and extract DFT and FF interaction energies for CO2 and H2O
run_binned_average: run binned_average to compute the average prediction error within specified energy bins for DFT adsorption data
run_get_Fig4a: run get_Fig4a to generate a histogram comparing raw FF minus DFT error distributions for CO2 and H2O
run_get_Fig4b: run get_Fig4b to generate a binned average error bar plot with KDE density overlay for CO2 and H2O
run_phys_err: run phys_err to calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption regime where DFT energies are between 0 and -0.5 eV
